data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 demands a causal mechanism for independence but offers only a counting proxy (evidence-ref overlap). The problem explicitly asks what evidence distinguishes genuine independent verification from mere restatement, and where a claim can be tested by counting or execution, say exactly what to count/execute. SRC_001 proposes counting citation-set overlap, but provides no causal story for WHY low overlap entails independent verification: two engines can cite disjoint evidence blocks yet still rest on the same latent shortcut/bias (restatement via different citations), or cite high-overlap blocks yet re-derive independently. The mechanism never identifies the distinguishing observable — it assumes correlation between lexical divergence and causal independence without justifying the link the problem asks it to establish.
